name: Shiroya
source:
Likes: Sunflowers
Dislikes: Dark, confining places
Hobby: Cooking
Home: Summer Village

What's behind his angelic smile...?

Shiroya is a member of the ninja team in the Summer Village called the Vermilion Bird School. His ancestor is Hyuga from the Fire Village.
Because his abilities as a Vermilion Bird ninja started to develop later than the others, he was put through severe training in a hidden village within the Summer Village when he was little. Now he has grown to be an excellent ninja in a position somewhat like a partner to Kaito.
His strength is his skills with the bow and arrow, just like his ancestor.

Currently, he stays with the head of the Summer Village's family.

[From in-game profile]
